stickymessages.label: Sticky messages
stickymessages.description: Keeps a message always at the bottom of a channel: it is re-posted on every new discussion.

g0.label: 📌 Sticky messages
g0.description: A message re-posted automatically at the bottom of the channel as people talk.

stickies.label: Messages
stickies.help: One row per channel: a message the bot keeps at the bottom. On each new message it deletes its own and reposts it below — so a busy channel makes it churn constantly, and every repost costs the channel's followers another notification. Best kept for quiet channels where one instruction must stay in view.

repost.label: Repost a message
repost.help: Deletes the old sticky message and reposts it at the bottom of the channel.

msg.pickChannel: Pick a channel that has a sticky message.
